statement.text: What is truly classic doesn't fade with time: it grows into everyday life. We don't look back. We build cars where enduring design meets new energy intelligence.

v27.alt: Sand-coloured iCAUR V27 on a desert dirt track

v25.line: The new iCAUR SUV is on its way.
v25.text: Leave your email and we'll tell you when it reaches our dealers.
v25.alt: Close-up of the new V25's round headlight in low light

items.label: i-AWD
items.title: One motor per axle
items.text: 150 kW at the front, 185 kW at the rear. All-wheel drive splits the power on its own, on tarmac and on sand.
items.alt: Top view of the V27 platform with its two electric motors

items.label: REEV
items.title: Electric, without range anxiety
items.text: The Golden REEV system takes the V27 from 0 to 100 km/h in 5.9 seconds. The engine reaches 45.79% thermal efficiency and only works to recharge the battery.
items.alt: Engine of the Golden REEV range extender system

items.label: Safety
items.title: A steel cage around you
items.text: 11 transverse and 11 longitudinal beams, hot-formed steel at 39 key points and 32,186 N·m/deg of torsional rigidity.
items.alt: High-rigidity cage body of the V27
